newsitem.title: USA: NutraGenics board approves Lipogenics merger.
newsitem.headline: NutraGenics board approves Lipogenics merger.

text.p: NutraGenics Inc said Wednesday its board of directors had approved a merger with Lipogenics, the company's predecessor and license holder.
It said Lipogenics would merge with it through a stock swap on October 15 without elaborating.
NutraGenics said it would acquire the technology, patents and patent applications for Lipogenics' products and equipment.
Its officials were not immediately available to comment on the terms of the stock swap.
Before agreeing on the merger, NutraGenics had been licensing the technology from Lipogenics with an obligation to pay a royalty fee for using the technology.
NutraGenics, a biopharmaceutical company, makes and sells a dietary supplement derived from rice for cardiovascular circulation.
